Messages.Author: Markus Schlein
Messages.Body:
The ruling for Anathema is that there has to be a "reduction" is blood to
burn the Vampire.

Question: A Vamp with the card on and no blood on it, takes one damage in
combat is burned. Correct? (Just thinking of the "reduction" from 0 to 0,
but topor)

-Markus

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
Markus Schlein <y000...@tu-bs.de> wrote:
> Question: A Vamp with the card on and no blood on it, takes one
> damage in combat is burned. Correct? (Just thinking of the
> "reduction" from 0 to 0, but topor)

Nope. There has to be a reduction from more than zero blood to zero
blood, regardless of whether the vampire is going to torpor or not.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Markus Schlein wrote:
>
> The ruling for Anathema is that there has to be a "reduction" is blood to
> burn the Vampire.
>

> Question: A Vamp with the card on and no blood on it, takes one damage in
> combat is burned. Correct? (Just thinking of the "reduction" from 0 to 0,
> but topor)

No. Going from zero to zero is not a reduction (nor an increase) in blood -
it is "no change". Becoming unready (going to torpor) is not a factor, since
it is not mentioned on the card.
